commits.message:
fix(action): enable CGO dependencies for golangci-lint action

This change will install and enable CGO dependencies for the golangci-lint GitHub action. The golangci-lint GitHub action was failing to import the saml2aws package, because the package uses C functions and or libraries. The addition of CGO dependencies allow the golangci-lint GitHub action to complete as expected.

Signed-off-by: Rob Casale <rcasale48@verizon.net>

fix(actions): resolve reported issues in golangci-lint action

This change will fix the reported issued in the golangci-lint GitHub action related to the prealloc linter.

Signed-off-by: Rob Casale <rcasale48@verizon.net>

fix(actions): upgrade golangci/golangci-lint-action from v8 to v9, and add constant for duplicate string

This change will upgrade golangci/golangci-lint-action from v8 to v9, because Node20 has reached its end of life, and there is a new version of golangci/golangci-lint-action that now supports Node24. Also, we created a constant StringType to replace the duplicate strings since the lint GitHub action was failing.

feat(entraid): add group overage check before the STS call

This change will update the entra-id protocol to check for group overage regardlless of how the role ARN was provided. This should now return the same error message when a user supplies the AWS IAM role ARN through the --role-arn flag, or when a user selects the AWS IAM role through prompts.

Signed-off-by: Rob Casale <rcasale48@verizon.net>

fix(entraid): update rolesFromAWSRolesClaim to handle Entra ID JWT with a single AWS IAM role

This change will fix the logic within the rolesFromAWSRolesClaim function to handle an Entra ID JWT token that contains a single AWS IAM role. Also, we have created a unit test for this use case.

Signed-off-by: Casale, Robert <robert.casale@fmr.com>

feat(actions): add PR edit permissions to labeler

This change will update the labeler GitHub Action such that it has access to add a label to the newly created PR. This GitHub Action recently started failing, so this change should fix the issue.
